body.statement: For every \((p,k,m,M,s,V)\in\mathfrak T\), \(\mathcal M_{p,k}(m,M,s,V)\subset\mathcal M_{\mathrm{Lin}}\). The inclusion is strict because the published information model permits non-Gaussian arm marginals and imposes no sparse spectral or residual-floor margins.
body.justification: The inclusion makes explicit that the budget frontier is a structured theorem inside the published conditional-transport information model rather than a redefined causal target.
body.gap: Lin et al. (2025) work over a broader information class; sparse Gaussian margins are introduced here to obtain a quantitative selection frontier.
body.consumer: Readers can distinguish which conclusions transfer to general conditional transport and which rely on the tractable Gaussian planning subclass.
